Vaela.name: TextLabel
Vaela.text: Build. Trade. Conquer. Begin with your own small adventurer guild.

Vaela.name: TextLabel
Vaela.text: Sylvaris grows by leaving room for the next seedling. I am studying Greenwood plants with Mogra. Gather gently at the herb patch, keep what you need, and tell me what the forest taught you.

Sela.name: TextLabel
Sela.text: Build. Trade. Conquer. Begin with your own small adventurer guild.

Sela.name: TextLabel
Sela.text: Crosshaven is built on promises kept between strangers. Our cargo shelter needs a few sound boards before the next rain. Deliver the timber here and I will see it shared among every crew, whatever their homeland.

Sela.name: TextLabel
Sela.text: Complete A Company Takes Shape first

Borin.name: TextLabel
Borin.text: Build. Trade. Conquer. Begin with your own small adventurer guild.

Borin.name: TextLabel
Borin.text: Deepforge's best work is work that lasts. Rukk has the patience of a fine smith already. Practise two ingots in your guild forge; they remain yours, and every sound casting is one less wasted load of ore.

Borin.name: TextLabel
Borin.text: Complete From Ore to Iron first

Nyra.name: TextLabel
Nyra.text: Build. Trade. Conquer. Begin with your own small adventurer guild.

Nyra.name: TextLabel
Nyra.text: A useful map marks a safe way home as carefully as a discovery. I came from Astralis to compare the Ashen stone seams. Visit the marked outcrop and return with your observations; keep the stone for your guild.

RokaFreshBoot.name: TextLabel
RokaFreshBoot.text: Build. Trade. Conquer. Begin with your own small adventurer guild.

RokaFreshBoot.name: TextLabel
RokaFreshBoot.text: Borga says you know the value of a warm welcome. In Ironroot, a shared meal is how neighbours become friends. Bring a few herbs for our community pot; humans, elves, dwarves and Orcs all have a seat.

RokaFreshBoot.name: TextLabel
RokaFreshBoot.text: Complete A Hearth for Everyone first
